messages:
Aisha Patel: Morning team — quick triage pulse. Overnight +48 tickets (mostly billing + auth). Two accounts on SLA watch. Can everyone drop current queue counts and any live blockers? Also noticed the refund macro link still points to the old docs. @Jamal can you take routing + update the macro?

Jamal Reed: current queue 31 (15 billing, 10 auth, 6 misc). I can update macro in a few. Any high-priority account IDs to surface?

Priya Nair: queue 9 here (mainly retries). Blocker: one customer reporting repeated 502s from embeddings proxy in us-west — I raised infra ticket but no ETA.

Marco Li: queue 4. I'm on the auth spike (token validation errors, likely clock skew). Patch ready for review @Liz.

Liz Chen: on it, sending CR now. Also FYI we got a billing webhook flurry from VendorX at 02:11 that created a lot of dup invoices; filtering rule proposed.

Omar Hassan: queue 0, shadowing refunds. I can pair with Jamal on macro text and suggested copy for refunds to reduce follow-ups.

triage-bot: Automated alert: embeddings-proxy-us-west — increased 5xx rate over last 30m. Incident ticket #INC-2026-172 opened.

Jamal Reed: drafting macro update, proposing we standardize to the new billing portal link + reduce support copy. Proposed snippet below — please sanity check: 

```
Macro: refund-esc
Message: Hi {{customer_name}}, we've initiated the refund for invoice {{invoice_id}}. You can view status here: https://billing.redwood.ai/portal/invoices/{{invoice_id}}. If you need escalation, reply with URGENT and we'll prioritize.
Autofill: invoice_id, customer_name
Tags: billing, refund, portal
```

Priya Nair: LGTM but add note about expected timeline (3–5 business days) and link to chargeback policy.

Jamal Reed: updated macro with timeline + policy link. Pushed to /macros/staging. Will deploy to prod after one approval.

Aisha Patel: action items: 1) Jamal deploy macro (after Liz or Marco ok) 2) Marco continue auth hotfix CR 3) Priya keep infra ticket pinned and paste any ETA updates here 4) Omar help reduce follow-ups on refunds. Reassigning two SLA accounts to @Aisha for oversight.

Liz Chen: reviewed CR, left minor nits. Marco, once CI green I can approve and merge.

Marco Li: CI failing on one flaky test — rerunning. ETA ~12m.

Priya Nair: infra updated INC-2026-172: working hypothesis proxy overload; mitigation: rate-limit vendor webhooks and spin a second instance in us-west. ETA 20m.

Aisha Patel: perfect. If anyone needs escalation ping me DM. I'll post a brief summary to #support-status after macro is live and infra is stabilized. :thumbsup:

Jamal Reed: deploying macro to prod now, will comment when live.

triage-bot: Macro deploy triggered by Jamal Reed at 1769012438.

Jamal Reed: macro live at 1769012455. Updated docs link and timeline included.

Aisha Patel: thanks all — weekly triage metrics in the channel tomorrow but for today we have plan + owners. Closing thread for now, re-open if new criticals show up. :white_check_mark:
